measures.name: Average Days From Accepted Date to FY End
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX(
    ALL_FactReferral, -- Adjust the table as needed based on your filtering requirements
    VAR _FYEnd = MAX(DimDate_AcceptedDate[calendar_date])
    VAR _AcceptedDate = ALL_FactReferral[AcceptedDate]
    VAR _DischargeDate = ALL_FactReferral[DischargeDate]
    VAR _EndDate = 
        IF(
            ISBLANK(_DischargeDate),
            _FYEnd,
            MIN(_FYEnd, _DischargeDate)
        )
    RETURN
        IF(
            NOT(ISBLANK(_AcceptedDate)),
            DATEDIFF(_AcceptedDate, _EndDate, DAY),
            BLANK()
        )
)
